commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
She goes on, to her heart.

My heart, you think he shows no kindness only because he doesn’t know how I suffer, and you would go pining after him to tell him. You know nothing. He saw my suffering and left without kindness. It is foolish to think he will come just because you told him, away from the sight of it.
